capabilities: Browse cloud directories in the sidebar via WebDAV or S3
Insert signed Markdown links to cloud files into notes
Upload local attachments to the server and update references
Preview images, video, audio, documents, and PDFs inline
Manage and switch between multiple WebDAV/S3 accounts
extras: README is written mainly in Chinese with an English nav link; the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the roadmap marks in-note server file search and Office preview as shelved.
motivation: The author is a firm believer in keeping zero attachments inside the vault and is a heavy OpenList user ("坚定的 Obsidian 库内 0 附件使用者").
problem: Obsidian attachments live in the vault and consume local disk space, with no built-in way to browse cloud storage or link to hosted files.

relations.evidence: 通过 WebDAV 连接 OpenList 等服务以及对象存储（S3）
CloudAttach 支持使用 PDF.js 内联预览 PDF 文件
🌐 S3 对象存储 — 兼容 Cloudflare R2，理论上支持 AWS 等大部分对象存储服务
兼容 OpenList，理论上支持 Alist / 群晖 / 威联通 QNAP 等所有 WebDAV 服务

requires.name: WebDAV credentials and OpenList token, or S3 storage credentials

summary: WebDAV/S3 cloud file browser that inserts signed links to OpenList or object-storage files and uploads local attachments to free vault space.
